title: Episode 148: 🇸🇮 SRT23 - Robert Leahy on C++ in FinTech

sentences.en: We just finished walking through a beautiful piazza and there are people enjoying their final drink.
sentences.zh: 我们刚穿过一个美丽的广场，有人在享受他们的最后一杯饮品。

sentences.en: I gotta say, your composure during this walk is quite impressive.
sentences.zh: 我得说，你这一路走来的镇定真是让人印象深刻。

sentences.en: This might go down as the greatest interview, maybe even podcast of all time on ADSP.
sentences.zh: 这可能会成为 ADSP 历史上最棒的采访，甚至是有史以来最好的播客。

sentences.en: Welcome to ADSP, the podcast episode 148, recorded on June 21st, 2023.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到 ADSP 播客第 148 期，录制于 2023 年 6 月 21 日。

sentences.en: My name is Connor and today with my co-host Bryce, we record our final episode from the Slovenia 2023 road trip from the streets of Venice at night.
sentences.zh: 我是康纳，今天我和我的联合主持人布莱斯，在威尼斯夜晚的街头，录制我们 2023 年斯洛文尼亚公路旅行的最后一期节目。

sentences.en: And in this episode, we interview Robert Leahy about C++ in fintech on the way to the Rialto Bridge.
sentences.zh: 在本期节目中，我们在前往里亚尔托桥的路上采访了罗伯特·利希，聊聊金融科技领域的 C++。

sentences.en: That's right, folks, we record another episode walking through the streets of Venice.
sentences.zh: 没，错，各位，我们又在威尼斯街头边走边录了一期节目。

sentences.en: This one is an absolute blaSt.
sentences.zh: 这一期绝对超赞。

sentences.en: Hello, dear listener.
sentences.zh: 你好，亲爱的听众。

sentences.zh: 而且，正如我所说，康纳在这次公路旅行开始时说，这是前所未有的，科技播客以前从未有过公路旅行环节。

sentences.en: I don't think that's true.

sentences.en: However, this is now a tech podcast that has a road trip that's going to do a guest interview while walking through Venice.
sentences.zh: 不过，这现在是一个拥有公路旅行环节的科技播客，还将在威尼斯边走边进行嘉宾采访。

sentences.en: And that certainly has got to be something that's not been done before.

sentences.zh: 威尼斯这里的每公里节点率简直高得离谱。

sentences.en: And actually, if you heard last episode, I predicted that.
sentences.zh: 事实上，如果你听了上一期节目，我预测过这一点。

sentences.en: I predicted that this would be the case.
sentences.zh: 我预测过会是这样。

sentences.en: There's a pedal bar in front of me.

sentences.en: I'm very excited.
sentences.zh: 我很兴奋。

sentences.en: So you're probably not going to hear from me much because I'm going to be navigating.
sentences.zh: 所以你可能不会经常听到我的声音，因为我要负责导航。

sentences.en: You're going to be hearing from our guest, Rob, who we're going to introduce.
sentences.zh: 你会听到我们的嘉宾罗布的声音，我们要介绍他。

sentences.en: I assume Bryce is going to introduce at some point.
sentences.zh: 我想布莱斯会在某个时候介绍他。

sentences.en: And I actually don't know what we're going to talk about firSt.
sentences.zh: 我其实不知道我们首先要聊什么。

sentences.en: Are we talking about the dinner?
sentences.zh: 我们要聊晚餐吗？

sentences.en: Are we talking about the party?
sentences.zh: 我们要聊派对吗？

sentences.en: Let's introduce Rob.
sentences.zh: 我们来介绍一下罗布吧。

sentences.en: Let's introduce Rob.
sentences.zh: 我们来介绍一下罗布吧。

sentences.en: Hi, Rob.
sentences.zh: 嗨，罗布。

sentences.en: Would you like to introduce yourself?
sentences.zh: 你想做个自我介绍吗？

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: My name is Robert Leahy.
sentences.zh: 我叫罗伯特·利希。

sentences.en: I live in New York and I grew up in Canada.
sentences.zh: 我住在纽约，在加拿大长大。

sentences.en: And I'm a member of the ISO C++ committee.
sentences.zh: 我是 ISO C++ 委员会的成员。

sentences.en: And I sit in Lugue under the watchful eyes of Bryce here.
sentences.zh: 我在布莱斯的密切关注下参加卢格会议。

sentences.en: Well, thank you, Rob.
sentences.zh: 好的，谢谢你，罗布。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: What are we talking about today?
sentences.zh: 我们今天聊点什么？

sentences.en: Well, let's introduce Rob a little bit more.
sentences.zh: 嗯，让我们多介绍一下罗布。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: You said you're from Canada.
sentences.zh: 你说你来自加拿大。

sentences.en: You said you're living in New York now.
sentences.zh: 你说你现在住在纽约。

sentences.en: You're an ISO member.
sentences.zh: 你是一名 ISO 成员。

sentences.en: Why did you join the C++ committee?
sentences.zh: 你为什么加入 C++ 委员会？

sentences.en: I mean, I was interested in C++ from the time that I was in university.
sentences.zh: 我是从上大学的时候就开始对 C++ 感兴趣。

sentences.en: And you read secondhand about all the things that go on in the committee and how the language is evolving.
sentences.zh: 你会间接地读到委员会里发生的所有事情以及语言是如何演变的。

sentences.en: And when I got into learning about it, C++11 was new and then 14 came out.
sentences.zh: 当我开始了解它的时候，C++11 刚出来，然后 14 也出来了。

sentences.en: And so all that seemed very new and exciting.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切看起来都非常新鲜和激动人心。

sentences.en: And it was right there on the front of my mind.
sentences.zh: 它就一直在我的脑海里。

sentences.en: And then when I moved to New York and I started working in the community and going to CBPCon, I figured this is the next thing I should do.
sentences.zh: 后来当我搬到纽约，开始在社区工作并去参加 CppCon 时，我想这是我应该做的下一件事。

sentences.en: And one morning I was at the office very early, as I want to do, when a co-worker of mine who lives upstate came in unusually early for him.
sentences.zh: 有一天早上，我和往常一样很早就到了办公室，一个住在北部的同事比平时早了很多来到公司。

sentences.en: And he just looked at me and said, I'm not going to BelfaSt.
sentences.zh: 他看着我说，我不去贝尔法斯特了。

sentences.en: You should go.
sentences.zh: 你应该去。

sentences.en: And this was with 10 days of notice.
sentences.zh: 这是提前 10 天通知的。

sentences.en: And at the time, I was the kind of person who didn't travel very well.
sentences.zh: 当时，我是那种不太擅长旅行的人。

sentences.en: So it was all a whirlwind.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切就像是一场旋风。

sentences.en: But it was worth it in the end.
sentences.zh: 但最后还是值得的。

sentences.en: So what exactly do you do, like, work-wise?
sentences.zh: 那你具体是做什么的，工作方面？

sentences.en: So I work in financial technology.
sentences.zh: 我从事金融科技工作。

sentences.en: And that's pretty much all I've ever done in the C++ universe.
sentences.zh: 这几乎是我在 C++ 领域做过的全部事情。

sentences.en: Before that, I'm very ashamed to say that I wrote PHP code to put myself through university.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，我很不好意思地说，我写过 PHP 代码来赚取大学学费。

sentences.en: Is that a PHP hack or a PHP?
sentences.zh: 那是 PHP 奇技淫巧还是 PHP？

sentences.en: No, no hack at all.
sentences.zh: 不，完全没有什么奇技淫巧。

sentences.en: Just straight PHP.
sentences.zh: 就是纯正的 PHP。

sentences.en: Not even, I couldn't even convince the boss I had at the time to use any kind of framework.
sentences.zh: 甚至，我当时都无法说服老板使用任何类型的框架。

sentences.en: So we kind of, like, rolled our own.
sentences.zh: 所以我们基本上是自己摸索出来的。

sentences.en: And he insisted that there needed to be HTML in the mix or he couldn't understand the code.
sentences.zh: 他坚持认为代码中必须包含 HTML，否则他看不懂代码。

sentences.en: And it was very messy.
sentences.zh: 而且非常混乱。

sentences.en: But it paid the bills.
sentences.zh: 但它能付清账单。

sentences.en: And I managed to graduate with no student loan.
sentences.zh: 我设法在没有助学贷款的情况下毕业了。

sentences.en: So I guess I'm obligated to thank PHP for that, very unfortunately.
sentences.zh: 所以我想我不得不为此感谢 PHP，非常不幸的是。

sentences.en: PHP, check out plrank.com.
sentences.zh: PHP, check out plrank.com.

sentences.en: It's a top 10 language, baby.
sentences.zh: 这是前十名的语言，宝贝。

sentences.en: People hate on it.
sentences.zh: 人们讨厌它。

sentences.en: But it's popular.
sentences.zh: 但它很受欢迎。

sentences.en: What can we say?
sentences.zh: 我们能说什么呢？

sentences.en: I also, very early in my programming career, did write some PHP.
sentences.zh: 在我的编程生涯早期，我也写过一些 PHP。

sentences.en: I was very bad at it.
sentences.zh: 我技术很烂。

sentences.en: I'm just going to go out there and say that numbers can't necessarily speak to quality, you know?
sentences.zh: 我要直言不讳地说，数量并不一定能说明质量，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Like, I'm going to pick quality over quantity every time.
sentences.zh: 就像，我每次都会选择质量而不是数量。

sentences.en: And now that we've had this aside about PHP and my emotions have gotten a bit boiled up, I've forgotten what we were even talking about.
sentences.zh: 既然我们已经扯开了关于 PHP 的话题，而且我的情绪有点激动，我都忘了我们刚才在聊什么了。

sentences.en: We were talking about what you do.
sentences.zh: 我们刚才在聊你是做什么的。

sentences.en: Okay, so you work in financial technology.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以你从事金融科技工作。

sentences.en: And I feel like we don't hear a lot from, I'm going to take this.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们不常听到，我来接话。

sentences.en: We don't hear a lot from people in the fintech sector.
sentences.zh: 我们不常听到来自金融科技领域的人的声音。

sentences.en: Because a lot of people in the fintech sector, it is difficult for them to talk about their work.
sentences.zh: 因为金融科技领域的很多人，他们很难谈论自己的工作。

sentences.en: In particular, people who are, like, you know, HFT companies and stuff like that.
sentences.zh: 特别是那些，你知道的，高频交易公司之类的人。

sentences.en: They tend to not give conference talks.
sentences.zh: 他们往往不在会议上做演讲。

sentences.en: But, like, what specifically, what sort of software do you write?
sentences.zh: 但是，具体来说，你写什么样的软件？

sentences.en: And, like, what are the sort of things that you deal with in the code that you work with?
sentences.zh: 在你处理的代码中，你通常会遇到什么样的事情？

sentences.en: So when I first started working for the fintech startup I was working at, it was, there was a lot of bread and butter feed handler code.
sentences.zh: 当我开始为我工作的金融科技初创公司工作时，有大量的常规行情数据处理程序代码。

sentences.en: And anyone who works in HFT and is in that universe that you just alluded to, Bryce, will understand that, you know,
sentences.zh: 任何在高频交易工作并身处你刚才提到的那个世界的人都会明白，你知道的，

sentences.en: you're just basically trying to understand the protocol the exchange sends you and the exchanges are bad at documentation.
sentences.zh: 你基本上只是在试图理解交易所发送给你的协议，而交易所的文档写得很烂。

sentences.en: And then to the degree to which they're bad at documentation, they're even worse at implementing their own documentation.
sentences.zh: 而且在他们文档写得烂的程度上，他们实现自己文档的技术就更烂了。

sentences.en: So there's a lot of tribal knowledge and you're writing C++ code and you're having people look over your shoulder and hand-wring about performance.
sentences.zh: 所以有很多行业内部知识，你写着 C++ 代码，身边有人盯着你的肩膀，对性能忧心忡忡。

sentences.en: But that's really the entry level to, you know, the financial technology industry.
sentences.zh: 但那真的只是进入金融科技行业的入门水平。

sentences.en: And the company I worked for, we weren't doing trading.
sentences.zh: 我当时工作的公司，我们不做交易。

sentences.en: So we were trying to, like, appeal to all the stakeholders in, you know, finance and programming, HFT, etc.
sentences.zh: 所以我们试图吸引金融和编程、高频交易等领域的所有利益相关者。

sentences.en: And so my experience with financial technology programming has taken me on a tour that's included things like writing feed handlers,
sentences.zh: 因此，我在金融科技编程方面的经历带我经历了一段旅程，其中包括编写行情数据处理程序，

sentences.en: writing drop copy on top of custom in-house fix engines and then writing that fix engine,
sentences.zh: 在定制的内部 FIX 引擎之上编写订单回显，然后编写该 FIX 引擎，

sentences.en: to writing a time series database that, you know, eventually got put on ice but occupied three years of my professional time.
sentences.zh: 到编写一个时间序列数据库，你知道的，这个数据库最终被搁置了，但占了我三年的一半职业生涯。

sentences.en: And, you know, I ended up getting a patent out of, so I'm okay with that.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我最终因此获得了一个专利，所以我对此感到满意。

sentences.en: Did that get replaced by an external time series DB or why did that get shelved?
sentences.zh: 那个被外部的时间序列数据库取代了吗，或者为什么被搁置了？

sentences.en: So my company went, you know, I worked for a startup.
sentences.zh: 所以我的公司经历了，你知道的，我曾在一家初创公司工作。

sentences.en: What, for not everybody may know, what is a time series database?
sentences.zh: 为了让不一定每个人都知道，什么是时间序列数据库？

sentences.en: So a time series database is a database engine whose primary method of querying and storing data is based on when it occurs in time.
sentences.zh: 时间序列数据库是一种数据库引擎，其查询和存储数据的核心方法基于数据在时间上发生的时间点。

sentences.en: So the data it stores is a time series where every item is keyed by exactly one key.
sentences.zh: 因此它存储的数据是一个时间序列，其中每个项目都由且仅由一个键进行键控。

sentences.en: In our case, it was two keys, which is one of the novel things that we added because we had a product and a time.
sentences.zh: 在我们的案例中，是两个键，这是我们添加的创新点之一，因为我们既有产品又有时间。

sentences.en: But the primary value add is that everything is keyed on a time.
sentences.zh: 但主要的价值在于一切都以时间为键。

sentences.en: And if you want all the data between two times, you can very easily get it.
sentences.zh: 如果你想要两个时间之间的所有数据，你可以非常容易地获取它。

sentences.en: The database is built from the ground up to retrieve that extremely quickly.
sentences.zh: 这个数据库从底层开始构建就是为了极其快速地检索这些数据。

sentences.en: And in finance, it's very important because one of the queries that people want to perform very often in finance is to understand what happened between these two times of intereSt.
sentences.zh: 在金融领域，这非常重要，因为金融界人们经常想要执行的查询之一，就是了解在关注的这两个时间之间发生了什么。

sentences.en: And a time series database from the ground up is built to do exactly that.
sentences.zh: 而时间序列数据库从底层就是为了完全做到这一点而构建的。

sentences.en: And to answer the question that Connor just asked about, you know, why this thing was wound down,
sentences.zh: 为了回答康纳刚才问的问题，关于为什么这东西被停掉了，

sentences.en: really it's because the company that I was working for that was producing this database, that got the patent on it, that made it into an ecosystem,
sentences.zh: 其实是因为我当时工作的这家生产这个数据库、为其获得专利并将其打造成生态系统的公司，

sentences.en: we got acquired and, you know, when you get acquired, a lot of priorities get reshuffled.
sentences.zh: 我们被收购了，你知道的，当你被收购时，很多优先级会被重新洗牌。

sentences.en: You're trying to integrate with a new business.
sentences.zh: 你得努力与新业务进行整合。

sentences.en: And this is one of the things that got put on ice as we tried to integrate with a new company, which is still an effort that's ongoing.
sentences.zh: 在我们努力与新公司整合的过程中，这就是被搁置的事情之一，而这项工作目前仍在进行中。

sentences.en: That's one of the reasons why a lot of my old talks and appearances are under May Street and the new ones are under the London Stock Exchange Group.
sentences.zh: 这也是为什么我的很多旧演讲和公开露面都在 May Street 名下，而新演讲都在伦敦证券交易所集团名下。

sentences.en: Very interesting.
sentences.zh: 非常有趣。

sentences.en: So, you got an idea?
sentences.zh: 所以，你有什么想法吗？

sentences.en: Oh, no, I was focusing on where we're going.
sentences.zh: 哦，没有，我刚才在专心看我们要去的地方。

sentences.en: I was just, I mean, we, Bryce and I, we haven't ever talked about this on the podcast, but we do personally have an interest in time series DB.
sentences.zh: 我只是……我是说，我们，布莱斯和我，我们在播客里从来没讨论过这个，但我们个人确实对时序数据库很感兴趣。

sentences.en: Here's actually a random question.
sentences.zh: 其实这里有个随性的问题。

sentences.en: Having worked in the financial space, are you familiar with the Q and KDB plus technologies?
sentences.zh: 你在金融领域工作过，熟悉 Q 和 KDB plus 这些技术吗？

sentences.en: The answer probably is no, but maybe a small chance it might be yes.
sentences.zh: 答案可能是不熟悉，但也有一点点可能是熟悉的。

sentences.en: So, in terms of familiarity, like personal experience with Q and KDB, and I think there's also K in the mix there.
sentences.zh: 所以，就熟悉程度而言，比如对 Q 和 KDB 的个人经验，而且我记得其中还夹杂着 K 语言。

sentences.en: The answer to that is no personal familiarity.
sentences.zh: 答案是个人并不熟悉。

sentences.en: But we have had clients because, you know, as a startup, we tried to dabble in a lot of areas.
sentences.zh: 但我们确实有过这样的客户，因为你知道，作为一家初创公司，我们尝试涉足很多领域。

sentences.en: We tried to get traction in a lot of areas.
sentences.zh: 我们试图在很多领域获得业务吸引力。

sentences.en: One of the areas we were getting traction is because one of our big focuses was on lossless packet capture and the value add on top of that.
sentences.zh: 我们获得吸引力的领域之一，是因为我们的一个核心重点是无损数据包捕获以及在此基础上的增值。

sentences.en: We were looking at putting stuff in KDB databases using all these languages.
sentences.zh: 我们曾考虑使用所有这些语言将数据存入 KDB 数据库。

sentences.en: And I never got direct exposure to that except to have people vent at me that it was not a great technology in their opinion.
sentences.zh: 我从来没有直接接触过，只是听别人向我发牢骚，在他们看来这不是一项好技术。

sentences.en: And now I can't vouch for the veracity of their opinion or whether it's grounded in truth.
sentences.zh: 现在我无法保证他们意见的真实性，也不知道它是否站得住脚。

sentences.en: But that was the hearsay that I got.
sentences.zh: 但这就是我听来的小道消息。

sentences.en: And I've heard pushback against that when I've gone over drinks with people and gossip with them.
sentences.zh: 当我跟人喝酒聊天、八卦时，我也听到过对此的反对声音。

sentences.en: And, as I said, I have no personal way of corroborating that.
sentences.zh: 而且，正如我所说，我个人没有办法证实这一点。

sentences.en: But that's the hearsay, at least within the company that I work for.
sentences.zh: 但这就是小道消息，至少在我工作的公司里是这样。

sentences.en: Are you able to state this is spicy stuff because my other podcast, ArrayCast, is representing that community, not Q specifically, but we do have a Q representative.
sentences.zh: 你能说这很劲爆吗？因为我的另一个播客 ArrayCast 代表了那个社区，不是特指 Q，但我们确实有 Q 的代表。

sentences.en: Are you able to say, not by name, the people, obviously, because we never want to call out people,
sentences.zh: 你能说吗，当然不能点名，因为我们永远不想公开点名某人，

sentences.en: but is it folks from a certain company or a certain sub-industry of fintech that have said that?
sentences.zh: 但说这话的是来自某个特定公司或金融科技某个细分行业的人吗？

sentences.en: Or is it just sort of a smorgasbord?
sentences.zh: 还是说只是各种各样的人都有？

sentences.en: I mean, we want the spicy.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们想要劲爆的内容。

sentences.en: We love spicy content.
sentences.zh: 我们喜欢劲爆的内容。

sentences.en: Hot takes are what drive ratings.
sentences.zh: 博眼球的言论才是收视率的驱动力。

sentences.en: So I think the people who have said this to me in the past were people who are coming at that platform from an outside engineering perspective.
sentences.zh: 所以我想，过去对我说这些话的人，都是从外部工程的角度来看待那个平台的人。

sentences.en: Like, they kind of came in with engineering first principles in mind,
sentences.zh: 就像，他们带着工程第一性原理的想法介入进来，

sentences.en: and they didn't have a lot of the context around the development and emergence of KDB and its associated languages loaded into their brain.
sentences.zh: 而他们的大脑中并没有加载太多关于 KDB 及其相关语言的发展和演变背景。

sentences.en: And so maybe some of those design decisions made sense to the stakeholders in the area.
sentences.zh: 所以也许其中的一些设计决策对那里的利益相关者来说是合理的。

sentences.en: But for someone looking in, it just looked like a mess.
sentences.zh: 但对旁观者来说，它看起来就像一团糟。

sentences.en: And so I ended up with basically a stream of complaints about it washing over me.
sentences.zh: 因此，我最终基本上听到了铺天盖地的抱怨声。

sentences.en: And that formed my opinion of it in a way that, like, as I admitted before, isn't, you know, informed by my own firsthand experience,
sentences.zh: 这让我对它形成了某种看法，正如我之前承认的那样，这不是由我自己的第一手经验决定的，

sentences.en: but just sort of by hearsay, which, as I said before, can be very lossy.
sentences.zh: 而只是通过道听途说，正如我之前所说，这可能会丢失很多信息。

sentences.en: But that's my impression, is my impression is people came in with expectations they had from other areas of software engineering.
sentences.zh: 但这就是我的印象，我的印象是人们带着他们在软件工程其他领域形成的期望来到这里。

sentences.en: They came into this very specific space where I think there's only one contender.
sentences.zh: 他们进入了这个我认为只有一个竞争者的极其特殊的领域。

sentences.en: You know, they were immersing themselves in a lot of tribal knowledge they didn't quite understand, and they had nothing but complaints about it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们沉浸在很多他们并不太理解的圈内知识中，对它除了抱怨还是抱怨。

sentences.en: And I think a lot of that, combined with the novelty of our use case, led to us designing our own time series database,
sentences.zh: 我想这一切，再加上我们用例的新颖性，促使我们设计了自己的时序数据库，

sentences.en: because I think we did look at KDB, and it was decided that it wasn't fit for the purpose that we had particularly.
sentences.zh: 因为我想我们确实考察过 KDB，但经过判定，它不适合我们特定的用途。

sentences.en: Yeah, so it's something to be implicit in this conversation that Rob and I have been having back and forth.
sentences.zh: 是的，罗布和我来回讨论的这件事，其实是谈话中不言而喻的。

sentences.en: But for folks that haven't picked up on it, KDB Plus is a time series database that is, to a certain extent,
sentences.zh: 但对于还没听出来的人来说，KDB Plus 是一种时序数据库，在某种程度上，

sentences.en: quite popular across certain firms in the financial space, which is why I asked about it.
sentences.zh: 它在金融领域的某些公司中相当受欢迎，这也是我问起它的原因。

sentences.en: Anyways, very interesting.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，非常有趣。

sentences.en: We were going to have to have more guests with time series DB experience to get to the bottom.
sentences.zh: 我们得请更多有时序数据库经验的嘉宾来探个究竟。

sentences.en: Yeah, because, you know, the language, the executable, was sold for $100 million, and it is, by the people that hold it in high regards, it is highly regarded.
sentences.zh: 是的，因为你知道，这个语言的执行程序曾以 1 亿美元的价格售出，而且在那些高度推崇它的人看来，它备受推崇。

sentences.en: But, you know, that's the thing, is I think there are mixed opinions.
sentences.zh: 但你知道，就是这样，我认为大家的看法不一。

sentences.en: And you should explain that it is associated with a particular array programming language.
sentences.zh: 你应该解释一下，它与一种特定的数组编程语言有关。

sentences.en: Yeah, so when Rob mentioned that Q was sort of in the mix, so go check out, I will link it in the show notes, an episode from ArrayCast where we talk about the history of K.
sentences.zh: 是的，所以当罗布提到 Q 也在其中时，去看看 ArrayCast 的一期节目——我会在shownotes里放链接——我们在那里讨论了 K 的历史。

sentences.en: And actually, we did a little history of K.
sentences.zh: 其实，我们做了一点 K 的历史回顾。

sentences.en: We did it, because it was really fascinating.
sentences.zh: 我们做了，因为这真的很吸引人。

sentences.en: Yeah, so the short version, though, is that there's been K0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, and 9 is the latest, which is ShaktiDB.
sentences.zh: 是的，长话短说，有 K0、1、2、3、4、5、6、7，最新的是 9，也就是 ShaktiDB。

sentences.en: But K4 was spun into a company called KX and was sold for $100 million.
sentences.zh: 但 K4 被分拆成了一家名为 KX 的公司，并以 1 亿美元的价格售出。

sentences.en: But one of the caveats was that K is an ASCII language.
sentences.zh: 不过其中一个条件是，K 是一种 ASCII 语言。

sentences.en: It only uses ASCII symbols, and the people that were buying the executable first derivatives,
sentences.zh: 它只使用 ASCII 符号，而购买这些执行程序衍生版本的人——

sentences.en: which is a company based in Ireland, did not want to use an ASCII-based language that is just kind of line noise, according to them.
sentences.zh: 那是一家总部位于爱尔兰的公司——不想使用基于 ASCII 的语言，在他们看来，那只是一堆噪音。

sentences.en: So they asked for a wordified version.
sentences.zh: 所以他们要求出一个单词化的版本。

sentences.en: And Q is that wordified version.
sentences.zh: 而 Q 就是那个单词化的版本。

sentences.en: They basically, instead of, you know, writing a slash for a reduction, which is what that is in the K language.
sentences.zh: 基本上，他们不再……你知道，用斜杠表示规约（reduction），在 K 语言中就是这样的。

sentences.en: Did you really mean ASCII symbols when...
sentences.zh: 你真的是指 ASCII 符号当……

sentences.en: Yeah, every function is a single ASCII character in the K language.
sentences.zh: 对，在 K 语言中，每个函数都是一个单独的 ASCII 字符。

sentences.en: But in Q...
sentences.zh: 但在 Q 中……

sentences.en: In a single ASCII character.
sentences.zh: 在一个单独的 ASCII 字符里。

sentences.en: Yes, so like exclamation mark, plus, slash, minus, etc.
sentences.zh: 对，比如感叹号、加号、斜杠、减号等。

sentences.en: And, you know, comma, everything maps to a function.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，逗号，所有东西都映射到一个函数。

sentences.en: And in Q, instead of using a single ASCII character, they added a word for every ASCII character.
sentences.zh: 而在 Q 中，他们没有使用单个 ASCII 字符，而是为每个 ASCII 字符添加了一个单词。

sentences.en: So, now instead of being able to say plus slash with two ASCII characters, you would say...
sentences.zh: 所以，现在你不能用两个 ASCII 字符说“加号 斜杠”，而是要说……

sentences.en: I'm actually not sure if they added plus as a keyword for the plus symbol, because I think plus is pretty well known by everyone.
sentences.zh: 其实我不太确定他们是否把 plus 添加为加号符号的关键词，因为我觉得大家都挺熟悉加号的。

sentences.en: But you would say plus over.
sentences.zh: 但你会说 plus over。

sentences.en: Technically, I think it's parentheses plus, parentheses over.
sentences.zh: 严格来说，我认为是括号 plus，括号 over。

sentences.en: But anyways, the details don't matter.
sentences.zh: 不过没关系，细节不重要。

sentences.en: And they also added shortcut conveniences, so you would never actually spell parentheses plus, parentheses over.
sentences.zh: 他们还添加了快捷方式，所以你实际上根本不用拼出括号 plus、括号 over。

sentences.en: You would spell some.
sentences.zh: 你会直接拼出 sum（求和）。

sentences.en: Because keywords were added to K.
sentences.zh: 因为关键词被加入了 K 中。

sentences.en: That became Q.
sentences.zh: 这就成了 Q。

sentences.en: That's what they sold.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们卖出去的东西。

sentences.en: Why am I so out of breath?
sentences.zh: 为什么我这么喘不上气？

sentences.en: So, Connor is a little bit out of breath, because we just walked up a bridge to cross the Grand Canal of Venice.
sentences.zh: 所以，康纳有点喘不上气，因为我们刚刚走上了一座桥，准备穿过威尼斯大运河。

sentences.en: Because we are now headed towards the other bridge.
sentences.zh: 因为我们现在正朝另一座桥走去。

sentences.en: Wait, how do you know that's the Grand Canal?
sentences.zh: 等等，你怎么知道那是大运河？

sentences.en: Because that's what Rob told me earlier.
sentences.zh: 因为那是罗布刚才告诉我的。

sentences.en: So, okay, back to a different topic from earlier.
sentences.zh: 好吧，回到刚才的另一个话题。

sentences.en: What is a feed handler?
sentences.zh: 什么是行情处理器（feed handler）？

sentences.en: I mean, before we end the discussion about KDB, I was reloading the context.
sentences.zh: 我是说，在我们结束关于 KDB 的讨论之前，我正在脑海中重新加载上下文。

sentences.en: This was from several years ago into my mind.
sentences.zh: 这是几年前的事了。

sentences.en: And one of the things that Bear is pointing out is the use case that we had that we were trying to fit KDB into was very particular.
sentences.zh: 贝尔指出的一点是，我们试图将 KDB 硬塞进去的那个用例非常特殊。

sentences.en: We were trying to, like, shove a lot of market data into it and then process a lot of market data out.
sentences.zh: 我们试图将大量的市场数据塞进去，然后再处理大量的市场数据输出。

sentences.en: And I think that a lot of the K queries were too pre-canned and involved a lot of caching things in memory, if I remember correctly,
sentences.zh: 如果我没记错的话，我认为许多 K 语言的查询都太过于套磁（预置），并且涉及大量在内存中缓存东西的操作，

sentences.en: whereas we were looking for a more stream-based approach.
sentences.zh: 而我们寻找的是更偏向流式处理的方法。

sentences.en: And that may have been where some of the friction came from.
sentences.zh: 这可能就是产生某些摩擦的地方。

sentences.en: Again, I'm not 100% certain of all the details, because I didn't do that exploration.
sentences.zh: 同样，我不能百分之百确定所有细节，因为那次探索不是我做的。

sentences.en: I just know we did not find it fit for purpose, which is something that a lot of people I've gossiped with in the financial technology industry have found very interesting indeed,
sentences.zh: 我只知道我们发现它不适合我们的用途，我和金融科技行业的许多人八卦时，他们确实觉得这非常有趣，

sentences.en: because a lot of them are very interested in KDB and use it as their one and only tool for a lot of these jobs.
sentences.zh: 因为他们中的很多人对 KDB 非常感兴趣，并将其用作完成许多这类工作的唯一工具。

sentences.en: Sorry, Bryce, back to you.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，布莱斯，回到你这里。

sentences.en: What was your question?
sentences.zh: 你的问题是什么？

sentences.en: And we're going to have to have FinTechWatch now.
sentences.zh: 我们现在必须得有“金融科技观察”（FinTechWatch）了。

sentences.en: We're going to have Bing people, because we don't – I mean, it's hard to get people from hedge funds and HFT firms on.
sentences.zh: 我们得找些懂行的人，因为我们——我的意思是，很难请到对冲基金和高频交易公司的员工。

sentences.en: But clearly, Rob's chatting with us because he doesn't work for, you know, a proprietary trading desk and doesn't have to worry about getting his hand slapped.
sentences.zh: 但显然，罗布在跟我们聊天，因为他不是为某种自营交易台工作，不需要担心被敲打手心。

sentences.en: There's probably more of these folks out there that we could be talking to.
sentences.zh: 外面可能还有更多这样的人我们可以聊聊。

sentences.en: So, FinTechWatch, ADSP listeners, you heard it here firSt.
sentences.zh: 所以，“金融科技观察”，ADSP 的听众们，你们在这里第一次听到。

sentences.en: We're going to get more folks like Rob on.
sentences.zh: 我们要请更多像罗布这样的人来。

sentences.en: Or maybe Rob is just going to be the only guy we talk to in the FinTech space, and we're going to have him back as a regular podcast gueSt.
sentences.zh: 或者罗布可能会成为我们在金融科技领域交流的唯一一个人，我们会让他作为固定播客嘉宾回归。

sentences.en: Anyways, what is a feed handler?
sentences.zh: 不管怎样，什么是行情处理器？

sentences.en: So, the way that a lot of financial exchanges work – and when I say a lot of financial exchanges,
sentences.zh: 所以，很多金融交易所的运作方式——当我说是很多金融交易所时，

sentences.en: one of the things that's coming out of the expansion of my company is the fact that a lot of this knowledge that I have is very strongly America-centric and perhaps Europe-centric.
sentences.zh: 随着我公司的扩张，我意识到的其中一件事是，我拥有的这些知识很大程度上以美洲为中心，也许还有欧洲为中心。

sentences.en: So, the markets in America and Europe function by broadcasting UDP multicast data to recipients who receive it.
sentences.zh: 因此，美洲和欧洲的市场运作方式是通过向接收者广播 UDP 多播数据来工作的。

sentences.en: And a feed handler would be something that takes that data off the wire, parses it, and makes sense of it in some way.
sentences.zh: 而行情处理器就是这样一种东西：它从网络上获取这些数据，对其进行解析，并以某种方式理解它。

sentences.en: Like,
sentences.zh: 比如，

sentences.en: provides you some kind of structured data you can interact with in C++ or your language of choice that allows you to actually make sense of the data as something other than zeros and ones.
sentences.zh: 为你提供某种结构化数据，你可以用 C++ 或你选择的语言与之交互，让你真正把数据理解为不仅仅是零和一的东西。

sentences.en: The degree to which you –
sentences.zh: 你达到什么程度——

sentences.en: It's always UDP?
sentences.zh: 一直都是 UDP 吗？

sentences.en: Right, and so that's what I was alluding to when I said that a lot of this knowledge that I have from working for this startup is centered around America and Europe.
sentences.zh: 对，这就是我刚才暗示的意思：我从这家初创公司工作所获得的很多知识都集中在美洲和欧洲。

sentences.en: In America and Europe, primarily, the data is transmitted via UDP.
sentences.zh: 在美洲和欧洲，数据主要通过 UDP 传输。

sentences.en: Throughout the rest of the world, for example, Asia and the Middle East, it's a mix, right?
sentences.zh: 而在世界其他地方，例如亚洲和中东，情况则五花八门，对吧？

sentences.en: A lot of the exchanges do transmit the data via UDP, but others choose to do so via TCP unicast,
sentences.zh: 许多交易所确实通过 UDP 传输数据，但其他交易所选择通过 TCP 单播传输，

sentences.en: which calls into question a lot of the software patterns that we use for handling this market data because they still have market data in the sense that we think of market data,
sentences.zh: 这就让人对我们处理这些市场数据的软件模式产生了诸多疑问，因为他们仍然拥有我们所理解的那种市场数据，

sentences.en: right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: A stream of updates from the market, status updates, trades, orders, levels, et cetera, but they don't disseminate that information over a multicast channel.
sentences.zh: 来自市场的更新流、状态更新、交易、订单、档位等等，但他们并不通过多播通道分发这些信息。

sentences.en: Instead, you have to connect up, authenticate, subscribe to the data you're interested in, which may be some or all of it, and then receive it on a unicast channel,
sentences.zh: 相反，你必须连接、进行身份验证、订阅你感兴趣的数据（可能是部分或全部），然后在单播通道上接收它，

sentences.en: which is something that I think that a lot of firms that operate primarily in America and Europe aren't quite used to,
sentences.zh: 我认为这对于许多主要在美洲和欧洲运营的公司来说并不是很习惯，

sentences.en: and we're going through a little bit of a technical cultural shock in that area.
sentences.zh: 我们在那方面正在经历一点技术文化冲击。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有趣。

sentences.en: So, you alluded to this a little bit earlier, that all these various different feeds, that they have different formats and protocols,
sentences.zh: 所以，你刚才稍微暗示了一下，所有这些各种各样的行情源，它们有着不同的格式和协议，

sentences.en: and it sort of sounded a little bit like it may have been the Wild WeSt.
sentences.zh: 听起来有点像狂野西部。

sentences.en: To what degree are there standards or specifications for all this financial data, and is there an industry consortium or something that writes out that specification,
sentences.zh: 所有这些金融数据在多大程度上存在标准或规范，是否有行业财团之类的好编写出该规范，

sentences.en: or is it just like a certain company says this is what they're going to do?
sentences.zh: 还是说只是某家公司说他们打算这么做？

sentences.en: Like, how does that work?
sentences.zh: 这到底是怎么运作的？

sentences.en: I mean, since I've been developing this proprietary time series database that's recently been put on ICE, I've been taken a little bit out of that world.

sentences.zh: 但我不知道关于它有什么好说的。

sentences.en: It just consists of doing the heaviest weight you can in the snatch and the clean and jerk,
sentences.zh: 它只包括在抓举和挺举中做到你所能举起的最重重量，

sentences.en: which belies most people's expectations because they hear weightlifting and they just think of lifting weights, which is not the case.
sentences.zh: 这与大多数人的期望不符，因为他们听到举重就只想到举起重量，事实并非如此。

sentences.en: And the other way to disambiguate the sport is to say Olympic weightlifting.
sentences.zh: 区分这项运动的另一种方法是称之为奥林匹克举重。

sentences.en: But the fact of the matter is, is that I spend altogether too much time on C++ to ever consider going to the Olympics.
sentences.zh: 但事实是，我在C++上花费的时间实在太多了，根本无法考虑去参加奥运会。

sentences.en: So I can't call it that.
sentences.zh: 所以我不能那么叫它。

sentences.en: How long have you been lifting weights?
sentences.zh: 你练举重多久了？

sentences.en: I mean, lifting weights, going on eight years, weightlifting, something like seven years.
sentences.zh: 我是说，举铁，快八年了，举重，大约七年。

sentences.en: I did weight, you know, just lifting weights as a bodybuilder with a buddy of mine.
sentences.zh: 我以前做过，你知道的，和一个哥们儿作为健美运动员一起举铁。

sentences.en: And then I decided to structure my training more and be a powerlifter.
sentences.zh: 然后我决定让我的训练更有条理，成为一名力量举运动员。

sentences.en: And then I herniated three discs in my back and decided I wanted to really be a weightlifter.
sentences.zh: 接着我的背部椎间盘突出三个，并决定我真的想成为一名举重运动员。

sentences.en: But guess what?
sentences.zh: 但你猜怎么着？

sentences.en: We're getting our selfie too, folks.
sentences.zh: 我们也正在拍自拍，伙计们。

sentences.en: We are.
sentences.zh: 我们是认真的。

sentences.en: Oh, we are.
sentences.zh: 哦，我们确实在拍。

sentences.en: Spin around.
sentences.zh: 转过身去。

sentences.en: Get in there, Rob.
sentences.zh: 过来，罗布。

sentences.en: This is going down as the best podcast of all time, folks.
sentences.zh: 这将被载入史册，成为有史以来最棒的播客，伙计们。

sentences.en: We're at the top of the Rialto Bridge.
sentences.zh: 我们站在里亚托桥的顶端。

sentences.en: How does it feel?
sentences.zh: 感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: It feels wonderful.
sentences.zh: 感觉太棒了。

sentences.en: It is absolutely beautiful here.
sentences.zh: 这里绝对美丽。

sentences.en: I have been loving walking through the streets of Venice.
sentences.zh: 我一直很喜欢漫步在威尼斯街头。

sentences.en: It's a pity that tomorrow morning at 8.35 a.m.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，明天早上8点35分，

sentences.en: I have to fly to London and go home for an entirety of three days before I come back to London for CBPNC,
sentences.zh: 我必须飞往伦敦回家待整整三天，然后才能回到伦敦参加CBPNC，

sentences.en: which both of these two gentlemen have tried to convince me is perhaps not the wisest thing.
sentences.zh: 这两位绅士都试图让我相信这可能不是最明智的做法。

sentences.en: Not good for the trees.
sentences.zh: 对树木不太好。

sentences.en: All right, all right, all right, all right.
sentences.zh: 好吧，好吧，好吧，好吧。

sentences.en: But that's the plan.
sentences.zh: 但这就是计划。

sentences.en: I think we should probably sign off here.
sentences.zh: 我想我们大概应该在这里结束了。

sentences.en: Wait, we're not going to sign off yet.
sentences.zh: 等等，我们还不结束。

sentences.en: Let's ask a couple more.
sentences.zh: 我们再问几个人吧。

sentences.en: While we're at the top of the Rialto Bridge, we got two Canadians here.
sentences.zh: 既然我们正站在里亚尔托桥上，这里正好有两位加拿大人。

sentences.en: Yours truly.
sentences.zh: 在下正是不才。

sentences.en: Was born, raised Prince George, B.C., studied in Vancouver, live in Toronto now.
sentences.zh: 我出生并成长于卑诗省乔治王子城，在温哥华求学，现在住在多伦多。

sentences.en: We're here with Rob.
sentences.zh: 我们现在和罗布在一起。

sentences.en: Give us a little bit of your Canadian background, Rob.
sentences.zh: 罗布，给我们简单介绍一下你的加拿大背景吧。

sentences.en: So my Canadian background doesn't consist of more than one city.
sentences.zh: 我的加拿大背景其实很简单，只涉及一个城市。

sentences.en: I was born, raised, went to all the schools possible in Victoria.
sentences.zh: 我在维多利亚出生、长大，读完了所有能读的学校。

sentences.en: And listeners who may be in Victoria may be skeptical and think that I just went to elementary school, middle school, high school, and the University of Victoria.
sentences.zh: 身在维多利亚的听众可能会持怀疑态度，觉得我只是读了小学、初中、高中和维多利亚大学。

sentences.en: But that is not the case.
sentences.zh: 但事实并非如此。

sentences.en: I went to elementary school, middle school, high school, the University of Victoria, and then Camosun College,
sentences.zh: 我读了小学、初中、高中、维多利亚大学，然后是卡莫森学院，

sentences.en: and then back to the University of Victoria before I graduated and then left Canada and Victoria on Christmas Day 2016.
sentences.zh: 接着又回到了维多利亚大学，直到毕业，并在2016年圣诞节离开加拿大和维多利亚。

sentences.en: So you must have really loved, I mean, I've been to Victoria, it's lovely, but like you must have really loved Victoria.
sentences.zh: 那你一定真的很喜欢——我的意思是，我去过维多利亚，那里很美——但你一定非常喜欢维多利亚。

sentences.en: Why, what?
sentences.zh: 为什么，怎么说？

sentences.en: You didn't want to go somewhere else for college?
sentences.zh: 你上大学时就没想过要去别的地方吗？

sentences.en: I don't know that going somewhere else for college is something a lot of people in Canada really do,
sentences.zh: 我不知道去外地上大学是不是很多加拿大人会做的事，

sentences.en: unless they go to McGill or Waterloo, and that wasn't really something that I was interested in.
sentences.zh: 除非他们去麦吉尔大学或滑铁卢大学，而我对那并不太感兴趣。

sentences.en: And the University of Victoria has a really great software engineering program in particularity,
sentences.zh: 而且维多利亚大学的软件工程专业确实非常棒，

sentences.en: so I got to stay there, save some money, get a great education, and most importantly of all, perhaps, get my Iron Ring.
sentences.zh: 所以我得以留在那儿，省了点钱，接受了极好的教育，最重要的是，也许还拿到了我的铁戒指。

sentences.en: So it has an actual software engineering program, not just a computer science program.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个真正的软件工程专业，而不仅仅是计算机科学专业。

sentences.en: So are you like an actual engineer in the eyes of Canada?
sentences.zh: 所以在加拿大人眼里，你算是一个真正的工程师吗？

sentences.en: Depending on what you mean by Canada, then yes.
sentences.zh: 这取决于你对“加拿大”的理解，如果是的话，是的。

sentences.en: I mean, in Canada, being an engineer can mean one of a variety of things.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在加拿大，成为一名工程师可以意味着好几种不同的情况。

sentences.en: It can mean that you graduated from an accredited engineering school and got your Iron Ring, which I did,
sentences.zh: 它可能意味着你毕业于获得认证的工程学院并拿到了铁戒指，我确实拿了；

sentences.en: or it can mean that you went through the rigors of finding a professional engineer to study under for three years to become a professional engineer, which I did not do,
sentences.zh: 或者也可能意味着你历经严苛的选拔，找到一位专业工程师并在其手下学习三年以成为专业工程师，我可没这么做，

sentences.en: because I left for the United States two and a half weeks after I finished my last course.
sentences.zh: 因为我在完成最后一门课程的两周半后就动身去了美国。

sentences.en: Let's see the ring.
sentences.zh: 让我们看看戒指。

sentences.en: I want to see what this ring looks like.
sentences.zh: 我想看看这戒指长什么样。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: It is, in fact, an Iron Ring.
sentences.zh: 它确实是一枚铁戒指。

sentences.en: I don't have any way to verify its authenticity.
sentences.zh: 我可没有办法验证它的真伪。

sentences.en: I've got a sister with a partner that both have these rings.
sentences.zh: 我有个姐姐，她和伴侣两人都有这种戒指。

sentences.en: It's official.
sentences.zh: 这可是官方认证的。

sentences.en: I can verify it as a sibling of an engineer.
sentences.zh: 作为工程师的家属，我可以为它作证。

sentences.en: Do you have any other Canadian questions for Rob?
sentences.zh: 你还有关于罗布的加拿大问题吗？

sentences.en: Not any Canadian questions.
sentences.zh: 没有加拿大相关的问题了。

sentences.en: We'll wrap this up.
sentences.zh: 我们就聊到这吧。

sentences.en: We'll wrap potentially the greatest podcast, technical technology podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 我们要结束这个可能是最棒的技术播客了。

sentences.en: But listen, listen, this was honestly, can you believe it?
sentences.zh: 不过听着，听着，老实说，你敢相信吗？

sentences.en: We just walked 2.1 kilometers at a 10-minute pace.
sentences.zh: 我们以10分钟的配速刚走了2.1公里。

sentences.en: Is that good?
sentences.zh: 这算好吗？

sentences.en: And it's very good.
sentences.zh: 这非常好。

sentences.en: It's very good if you're just walking.
sentences.zh: 如果你只是散步的话，这已经相当不错了。

sentences.en: Most people walk slower than that.
sentences.zh: 大多数人走得都比这慢。

sentences.en: We did it.
sentences.zh: 我们做到了。

sentences.en: We recorded a golden content podcast with Rob.
sentences.zh: 我们和罗布录制了一期内容含金量极高的播客。

sentences.en: So the last thing I have to ask is, Rob, if people want to follow you online,
sentences.zh: 所以我要问的最后一件事是，罗布，如果人们想在网上关注你，

sentences.en: I'm not sure if you're writing papers, but I know you're giving talks at CppCon.
sentences.zh: 我不确定你是否还在写论文，但我知道你在 CppCon 上做过演讲。

sentences.en: You said that you're planning on, I think, proposing three talks for CppCon 2023.
sentences.zh: 你说过你正计划为 2023 年 CppCon 提交三场演讲，我想是的。

sentences.en: You've given six before, if my math checks out.
sentences.zh: 如果我没算错的话，你之前已经做过六场了。

sentences.en: So where can people follow you if they want to go watch your talks, find out more about you, follow you on the socials?
sentences.zh: 那么如果人们想去观看你的演讲、了解更多关于你的信息、在社交媒体上关注你，可以在哪里找到你呢？

sentences.en: I mean, on YouTube for my talks would be the best one.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在 YouTube 上看我的演讲会是最好的途径。

sentences.en: I nominally have a Twitter, but I haven't posted on there for four or five years.
sentences.zh: 我名义上有一个 Twitter 账号，但我已经有四五年没在上面发过东西了。

sentences.en: And I don't plan on starting, which a lot of people in tech would say is unfortunate.
sentences.zh: 而且我也不打算重新开始，科技圈的许多人可能会觉得这很遗憾。

sentences.en: Other than that, I have an Instagram.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，我还有一个 Instagram。

sentences.en: And it's just all of the four names that my parents gave me concatenated together.
sentences.zh: 账号就是我父母给我取的那四个名字连在一起。

sentences.en: But the only thing that I post on there is me lifting weights and eating food.
sentences.zh: 但我在上面唯一发的只有我举铁和吃东西的内容。

sentences.en: And so that doesn't really seem like it's very technical in nature.
sentences.zh: 所以这看起来并不怎么具有技术性。

sentences.en: No, go ahead and list out the handle.
sentences.zh: 不，干脆把账号报出来吧。

sentences.en: Some of our listeners may be interested.
sentences.zh: 我们的一些听众可能会感兴趣。

sentences.en: Vittorio might be interested because Vittorio lifts weights.
sentences.zh: 维托里奥可能会感兴趣，因为维托里奥也举铁。

sentences.en: We have some other...
sentences.zh: 我们还有一些……

sentences.en: We've got some people in the C++ community that like to lift.
sentences.zh: C++ 社区里有些人都挺喜欢举铁的。

sentences.en: That are into fitness, let's say.
sentences.zh: 可以说他们对健身很感兴趣。

sentences.en: I guess if you're into fitness and also into eating, then you can follow me on Instagram at Robert Allen.
sentences.zh: 我想如果你既喜欢健身又喜欢吃东西，那你就可以在 Instagram 上关注我，账号是 Robert Allen。

sentences.en: That's Allen with two A's and two L's.
sentences.zh: 就是有两个 A 和两个 L 的 Allen。

sentences.en: Hannigan Leahy.
sentences.zh: 汉尼根·利希。

sentences.en: That's my Instagram handle.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的 Instagram 账号名。

sentences.en: And Connor is laughing because that's so comically long.
sentences.zh: 康纳在大笑，因为这名字长得太滑稽了。

sentences.en: And believe me, I've heard that before from people who try to tag me in stories.
sentences.zh: 相信我，那些试图在动态里标记我的人以前也这么吐槽过。

sentences.en: They complain bitterly that my Instagram handle is altogether too long.
sentences.zh: 他们极其抱怨我的 Instagram 账号实在是太长了。

sentences.en: I mean, if they're using some app that doesn't autocomplete that, that's disappointing.
sentences.zh: 我是说，如果他们使用的某个应用没有自动补全功能，那就太令人失望了。

sentences.en: You should get three letters into that.
sentences.zh: 你只要输入前三个字母，

sentences.en: And if you follow Rob, that should autocomplete.
sentences.zh: 如果你关注了罗布，那就应该能自动补全。

sentences.en: I mean, what if you follow other Robs, though?
sentences.zh: 不过，万一你关注的是其他罗布呢？

sentences.en: There's no other Robs.
sentences.zh: 没有别的罗布。

sentences.en: I do have an Uncle Rob, but he's not on Instagram.
sentences.zh: 我确实有一个罗布叔叔，但他不用 Instagram。

sentences.en: I can think of like three other C++ Robs.
sentences.zh: 我还能想起其他大概三个 C++ 领域的罗布。

sentences.en: I mean, this is my favorite one, but I can't think of like three other ones.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这是我最喜欢的一个，但我也能想起其他大约三个。

sentences.en: Well, you know too many people.
sentences.zh: 好吧，你认识的人太多了。

sentences.en: Anyways, thank you, Rob.
sentences.zh: 总之，谢谢你，罗布。

sentences.en: This was groundbreaking historical stuff.
sentences.zh: 这是一次具有开创性和历史意义的访谈。

sentences.en: The listeners, you're going to be getting hit up on Instagram for sure by the fans of Bryce, the listeners of the pod.
sentences.zh: 听众们，布莱斯的粉丝、本播客的听众们肯定会在 Instagram 上疯狂@你的。

sentences.zh: 我想这也是我们为 2023 年斯洛文尼亚公路旅行录制的最后一期节目了。
